    print(f"Song {song_id}: {song_info['title']} - {artists}")

steps.code:
# Count unique songs per artist (each song counted once per artist it appears on)
from collections import Counter
artist_counts = Counter()
for song_id, artists in song_artists.items():
    for artist in artists:
        artist_counts[artist] += 1

# Sort by count descending, then by artist name for deterministic tie-breaking
sorted_artists = sorted(artist_counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
print(sorted_artists)
